fact: The former DOTMATRIX status system and its settings are no longer current. Pylon uses a fixed cross-client vocabulary: sky is active work, amber needs approval, indigo waits for user input, violet marks plan review, emerald is success, red is failure, and muted is idle or offline; only active progress may pulse, and Reduce Motion disables that motion.

Each OpenCode provider instance owns one lazy local helper server for catalog discovery and text generation; concurrent borrowers share it, and it closes 30 seconds after its last borrower or when the instance closes. Chat adapters still keep a server per thread because OpenCode keys MCP registrations by directory, so sharing would let same-directory threads replace each other's t3-code route. External servers remain externally owned.

OpenCode's server-wide event stream is projected into a Pylon thread only for that thread's root session. Verified descendant sessions may contribute approval and question request lifecycles, but their status, idle, error, and output events are filtered so child completion cannot settle or corrupt the parent turn.
The confirmThreadUnpin setting defaults to false and covers sidebar controls, thread menus, and the mod+shift+p command on web and desktop. Mobile intentionally unpins immediately.

Fresh-thread model seeding distinguishes ambient defaults from explicit user choices. On mobile the precedence is explicit unsent draft, valid project default, valid app-wide sticky choice, then provider default or first option; web also lets a project default outrank carried or sticky state for a fresh destination, while explicit picker or trait edits cannot be overwritten by later seeding.

Mobile drafts and the global sticky model share one file-backed document. Hydration must finish before persistence writes, and debounced writes, flushes, share-import transactions, restores, and environment cleanup must use one serialized async queue. Contentless drafts with importedShareIds are durable import receipts and must not be filtered out.

DPoP verifier failures cross server and relay boundaries only as stable safe categories: time_window, key_mismatch, request_mismatch, token_mismatch, replay, or invalid_proof. The field is optional for older peers; only time_window confirms a clock problem, while an absent category may mention clock skew only as a possibility.

An unpresented Electron preview webview suspends painting with visibility:hidden. It remains offscreen but rendered only while presented, picture-in-picture, recording, or a reference-counted automation activity lease requires it; automation acquires the lease before waiting for the overlay and releases it afterward.

Desktop previews open scripted HTTP(S) window.open requests as opener-preserving real windows for OAuth, while ordinary new-tab links navigate the preview, about:blank is excluded, and popup chains are denied. Popup windows force contextIsolation, disable Node integration, enable sandboxing, and clear the preview preload; allowpopups must be present when the webview attaches.

A failed first-send bootstrap may soft-delete and then recreate the same client-minted thread ID as a new incarnation. Projectors clear old per-thread rows on thread.created, replay preserves attachments when a later creation supersedes deletion, and WebSocket creation fences on ThreadDeletionReactor.drainThrough(createSequence) so old cleanup cannot stop new resources.

Codex app-server JSONL input framing must stay linear in input size: unfinished lines remain string fragments, each decoded chunk is scanned once for newlines, and fragments join only for a complete line or EOF. Repeatedly concatenating the remainder and splitting the whole buffer would restore quadratic copying for large messages.

Prime foreground prompt ownership has two explicit modes and is never inferred from text or generic busy state. The optional correlated lifecycle is enabled only by explicit capability negotiation; its correlation stays provider-private and generation-bound, and recovery requires complete attributed event continuity without synthesizing snapshot output. Stock daemons use the conservative observed-activity busy path.
